HOW IT WORKS

Real connections.
Engineered behavior.

01 / THE DATA

A wiring diagram, not a brain simulation.

MaleCNS v1.0 maps the male fruit fly central nervous system. Original neuron IDs become nodes; measured directed connection strengths become edges. It is structural data, not biological dynamics or learned plasticity.

02 / THE CONTROLLER

State in. Graph activity. Flap out.

Engineered adapters inject position, velocity, distance, gap boundaries, and previous action into selected input nodes. Sparse message passing follows fixed wiring; a learned readout produces a flap probability. This controller does not see pixels.

03 / THE QUESTION

Does the wiring make a difference?

Identical unseen seeds compare the original graph with shuffled wiring, an MLP, and interventions. These small experiments cannot establish that biological wiring is superior, simulate consciousness, or show a real fly playing a game.

Flappy Fly · A connectome-derived controller experiment.
